svg.text: SQLite (WAL) · 16 tables, 1 view · row counts from the snapshot of 26 Sep 2026

g.text: bar = one · crow's foot = many · PRAGMA foreign_keys is OFF, so even the solid links are held by the app
• org_id / site_id ride on almost every table as tenancy columns; only some of them declare a FOREIGN KEY.
• Timestamps are ISO-8601 TEXT in UTC. occurred_at is when it happened, received_at is when we got it.
• JSON lives in TEXT columns: event.evidence, tracked_thing.path, zone_camera.points, clip_frame.boxes, action.before / after.
• Images are base64 TEXT: event.thumbnail, clip_frame.jpeg, plate_detection.image_snapshot. clip_frame is nearly all of the 2.0 GB file.
• event.evidence.clipId points at clip.id from inside the JSON; nothing in SQL enforces it.
• incident.camera_id and zone_id are denormalised from the events that opened the incident; grouping is by group_key.
• action is append-only and hash-chained (prev_hash to hash). An incident's status is read back from its newest incident.* verb.
• camera.status is observed by the analysis engine (FULL to DEAD); camera.enabled is a person's decision. Two different facts.
